articles.detail: 5 cycles scheduled, 4 completed, avg 6 published/cycle — up from 35 yesterday

experiment: Skipped — the noNewExperimentsUntil gate (2026-07-28) covering the Opus 4.8 → Opus 5 migration is still in force, and no experiments are active to evaluate. Every headline metric cleared its target today anyway, so there is nothing a parameter change would be answering.
weakestArea: Asia at 5 of 42 is the furthest any region fell today, and it is the region the source list is best equipped to cover — Dawn, NDTV, Hindustan Times, The Hindu, News18 and Economic Times all published, but most of their output landed under ME or AM datelines rather than as Asian stories. Freshness p90 also stretched to 1.5 days against a 0.1 median, so a handful of standalone picks are a full day older than the rest of the file.
watching: A mine sinking a tanker in Hormuz alongside the Iran-US pause holding: the shipping-risk and diplomatic tracks are moving in opposite directions and one of them will break.
Israel's approval of a new Gaza force and settlers torching two mosques — escalation on two separate registers within the same day.
France evacuating 220,000 from wildfires, the largest single displacement figure in today's file and still rising.
India's exam-leak story moved from protest to institutional repair with Nilekani appointed; whether that closes the NEET arc is unresolved.
BitMart shutting after nine years plus a regulator warning on prediction markets — two crypto-adjacent enforcement signals in one cycle.
Karachi's water supply and Islamabad's ventilator shortage were filed as separate stories and are plainly one Pakistani capacity story.
coverageGaps: Oceania produced nothing for the second consecutive day; no source in the curated list is based there.
Asia fell to 5 of 42 despite six Indian and Pakistani outlets publishing — the subcontinent carried the bucket and East and Southeast Asia were near-absent.
Latin America appears only inside the AM bucket, which US coverage dominates; Venezuela and Cuba were the only distinctly Latin American pieces.
Science recovered its specialist bench (Nature 4, Phys.org 2), but tech's nine stories still lean on crypto and platform reporting rather than research or infrastructure.
context: A clean day after yesterday's writer stall: four of five cycles completed, 42 articles, zero duplicates, and a freshness median of 0.1 — the best of the month. The Opus 5 lineup is now three days into its re-baseline and the metrics it most directly drives (category mix 15/11/9/7, multi-source 9, 34 unique sources) all sit at or above pre-migration levels, which is exactly the signal the gate was opened to collect. The gate lifts on 2026-07-28; the first candidate then should be a feed-side lever rather than a selector-side one, since the 2026-05-16 evaluation established that the selector multi-source floor is exhausted and the binding constraint is upstream supply. TOP_EVENTS_TO_FETCH stays at 8 — each unit is one NewsAPI token per cycle and that spend is capped.
